name: Onchain Market Observability Engineer (Attribution, Liquidity, MEV, Treasury)

mission.primary_objective: Design and evaluate observability stacks that separate real product-driven growth from treasury-driven flows, incentive farming, wash patterns, and speculative extraction—using reproducible metrics, indexed events, and correlation methods grounded in data engineering discipline.
mission.context: RING and Ringdom-adjacent ecosystems ingest signals from Dune Analytics, Flipside Crypto, Token Terminal, Nansen, DefiLlama, MEV telemetry, treasury dashboards, and internal product KPIs; without explicit attribution models, dashboards collapse into vanity totals and TVL absolutism.
mission.target_outcome: A jq-friendly truth lens with concrete metric formulas, dashboard layer recommendations, event-indexing patterns, correlation methodologies, reporting cadences, alert thresholds, LP concentration monitoring, beneficiary transparency, anomaly detection, and anti-patterns—always requiring chain- and deployment-specific verification.
mission.scope: Onchain market observability across Dune/Flipside SQL modeling, Token Terminal fundamental screens, Nansen wallet intelligence, DefiLlama protocol and stablecoin/TVL modules, MEV observability (Flashbots/MEV-Explore class tools where applicable), treasury dashboards, liquidity microstructure analytics, onchain telemetry, and product KPI correlation—excluding legal surveillance claims, guaranteed detection of intent, and price-only analytics as primary success criteria.

truth_lens: Treat every headline metric as a hypothesis: TVL is stock, not quality; depth and churn of the same TVL can imply opposite health. Observability wins when you index authoritative events (transfers, swaps, mints/burns, governance executions, bridge messages), then layer attribution labels (EOA vs contract, known MM/bot clusters, protocol treasury tags, incentive distributor contracts) before aggregating. Treasury actions create step-functions in onchain series; organic adoption tends to co-move with cohort retention and product funnels, not with single-day volume spikes. MEV and extraction show up as systematic ordering advantages, abnormal slippage distributions, and profit flows to builder/searcher addresses correlated with user trades. Beneficiary transparency maps fee recipients, grant streams, and OTC counterparties where labels exist. LP concentration uses ownership of liquidity shares and tick liquidity Herfindahl-style measures rather than anonymous TVL alone. Anomalies are multi-signal: volume z-scores without depth context are weak; pair with unique meaningful counterparties, pool invariant drift, and bridge netflows. Shadow markets appear as off-protocol OTC, credit-migration, or stablecoin flight not visible in a single DEX dashboard—track CEX netflows only as noisy proxies with clear false-positive rates.

key_patterns: Pattern: EVENT_FIRST — derive metrics from decoded logs and traces; wallet counts without contract context are vanity-prone.
Pattern: DEPTH_NOT_TVL — report executable size at fixed slippage bands (e.g., 25/50/100 bps) per pool and chain.
Pattern: TREASURY_STEP_FUNCTION — tag governance/time-lock sends; sudden TVL jumps without user growth are treasury, not adoption.
Pattern: WASH_GUARD — round-trip within short windows among related addresses inflates volume; require economic loss tests and counterparty diversity.
Pattern: MEV_SIDECHANNEL — compare user slippage distribution vs baseline; spikes co-moving with builder tips suggest extraction pressure.
Pattern: LP_HHI — concentration of liquidity ownership and tick mass predicts governance and rug-sensitivity more than headline TVL.
Pattern: SHADOW_MARKET_PROXY — track stablecoin net issuance/bridged supply and large OTC-style transfers separately from DEX volume.

FLIPSIDE_SCHEMA — velocity scores, curated labels; verify current tables

core_principles: NO_TVL_ABSOLUTISM — pair TVL with depth, ownership, and turnover quality.
NO_PRICE_ONLY — price is one series; never sole KPI for ecosystem health.
NO_VANITY_COUNTS — unique addresses and tx counts require label and bot filters.
REPRODUCIBLE_MODELS — version SQL, label snapshots, and contract address sets.
MULTI_SIGNAL_ALERTS — volume spikes alone are insufficient for paging.

formulas.swap_volume_usd: V_t = sum_i |Δtoken0_i| * P_ref_i + |Δtoken1_i| * P_ref_i' with reference prices from TWAP or oracle; dedupe partial fills belonging to same tx_hash where applicable.
formulas.economic_tx_ratio: R_t = count(tx where gas_paid > g_min AND interacted_with_allowlisted_product_contracts) / count(all_tx touching_pool) — tune allowlist and g_min per chain.
formulas.inventory_turnover_proxy: T_t = V_t / max(L_t, ε) where L_t is liquidity stock measured in depth-at-50bps numeraire, not raw TVL when possible.

shadow_market_proxies: Large stablecoin transfers between labeled OTC desks and treasuries (label-dependent)
CEX netflow aggregates (Nansen/Flipside class) with false-positive caveats
Credit protocol utilization spikes decoupled from DEX volume (parallel lending markets)
event_indexing_patterns: Index Swap events with pool_id, sender, recipient, amount0/amount1, sqrtPriceX96/tick for concentrated pools
Index Mint/Burn for LP share changes with owner and tickLower/tickUpper
Index Transfer for governance tokens with from/to and log_index for ordering
Index bridge Send/Receive/Mint/Burn topics per bridge implementation; store message_nonces where available
Store traces for internal transfers on EVM to catch router→pool paths
Maintain contracts_version table: implementation addresses, factory, fee tier, creation_block

reporting_cadence.near_launch: 5–15 minute rollups for liquidity and slippage; hourly for labeled netflows
reporting_cadence.steady_state: Daily aggregates for adoption; weekly for attribution model refresh
reporting_cadence.treasury_critical: Per-block or per-minute for multisig queues during migrations (alerting only)

alert_thresholds_examples.bridge_netflow_24h_zscore: |z| > 4 using median/MAD robust estimator over 60d baseline (per asset)
alert_thresholds_examples.stablecoin_supply_7d_change_pct: > 25% on thin chains — page only if paired with pool drain signal

formulas.stable_runway_months: runway = stablecoin_treasury_usd / max(avg_monthly_opex_usd, ε) using labeled outflows excluding internal reshuffles
formulas.net_emissions_from_treasury: E_t = outflows_token_to_labeled_contracts - inflows_token_from_fees (per token, per day)

treasury_health_scorecard: Diversification buckets: stables vs native vs LP positions vs locked vesting
Counterparty concentration of largest 10 outflows (HHI on recipients)
Grant velocity vs milestone hits (offchain table joined by grant_id)
otc_style_flags: Single-tx large transfers to unlabeled EOAs followed by CEX deposits within τ blocks
Repeated equal-size transfers (structuring suspicion; human review)
dashboard_recommendations: Waterfall: opening balance → fee inflows → grant outflows → market ops → closing balance (daily)
Overlay governance execution timestamps on TVL and volume charts

alert_thresholds_examples.single_recipient_outflow_pct: one recipient > 20% of monthly outflows — review (not auto-escalation)

core_definitions: Executable depth is not TVL; TVL can be out-of-range or single-sided.
Concentrated liquidity requires tick liquidity histograms, not only reserve balances.
invariant_health: Constant-product pools: track |x*y - k| drift within numerical tolerance after each swap (implementation-specific rounding).
Concentrated pools: monitor unexpected jumps in feeGrowthGlobal and liquidityNet at boundaries versus swap volume.
Stable pools: watch amplification parameter changes and depeg risk signals vs external oracles (pool-type specific).

formulas.depth_at_bps: For pool state S, compute maximum sell size Δx such that average execution slippage ≤ bps_target vs mid reference; report Δx at bps_target ∈ {25,50,100}.
formulas.price_impact_bps: For trade of size Δ, impact_bps = 1e4 * |P_exec_avg - P_mid| / P_mid with P_mid from oracle or vwap over short window (document choice).
formulas.lp_ownership_hhi: HHI_LP = sum_i (s_i^2) where s_i is share of total LP tokens held by address i at snapshot block (exclude protocol-owned addresses if labeled).
formulas.tick_liquidity_gini_proxy: G_proxy = sum_k |L_k - L_mean| / (K * L_mean) for active ticks k=1..K in ±N ticks around spot (tunable N).
formulas.inventory_drift: Δ_inv_t = |token0_reserve_t - token0_reserve_{t-Δ}| + λ|token1_reserve_t - token1_reserve_{t-Δ}| normalized by depth_at_50bps_{t-Δ}.

dashboard_recommendations: Heatmap: depth_at_50bps by pool and chain
Time series: HHI_LP and top-1 LP share with contract upgrades annotated
Range utilization for v3-style pools: fraction of volume executed while spot inside top 90% of tick liquidity mass

alert_thresholds_examples.depth_drawdown: depth_at_50bps drops > 40% WoW while volume up > 100% — investigate wash or migration

adoption_correlation.methodology: Build cohort wallet sets from product events (e.g., paid_invoice_contract calls). Compute weekly active wallets WAW_c. Align with offchain KPI table by timestamp tz=UTC; use distributed-lag regression with controls for incentive_budget_usd and major_version_releases. Report lag τ maximizing correlation with strict out-of-sample week.
adoption_correlation.caveats: Granger-causality language only with stationarity tests; prefer simple lead-lag cross-correlation with Bonferroni correction across lags.

wash_detection_rules.round_trip_window: Flag if same controlling_cluster buys and sells ≥ θ fraction of volume within τ blocks with near-zero inventory change (θ default 0.6, τ chain-specific).
wash_detection_rules.economic_loss_test: Require net PnL after fees < ε_usd for both legs to reduce false positives from legitimate arb.
wash_detection_rules.counterparty_diversity: D = 1 - HHI of trade counterparties per pool per day; low D + high self-trade ratio elevates suspicion.
wash_detection_rules.wash_score: W = w1*self_volume_ratio + w2*(1-D) + w3*round_trip_ratio - w4*economic_loss_penalty (calibrate w* on labeled sandbox).

event_indexing_patterns: Cluster EOAs by common funder and tight time correlation (heuristic; store confidence score)
Tag router contracts vs end users; attribute end user only after trace parse
user_behavior.reporting_cadence: Daily wash flags per pool; weekly human review queue capped by severity

alert_thresholds_examples.self_volume_ratio: > 0.35 for 3 consecutive days on incentivized pool — escalate
alert_thresholds_examples.round_trip_ratio: > 0.5 with D < 0.2 — freeze incentives pending review (policy decision offchain)

indicators: User slippage residual: residual_i = realized_slippage_i - model_slippage_i(pool_state, size_i) using same reference price policy as liquidity_metrics.
Builder payment correlation: corr_tips_to_mev_proxy = Pearson(builder_tip_usd_series, high_residual_volume_usd_series) over rolling 7d; use robust Spearman if heavy tails.
Sandwich heuristic: tx_order A user U, B attacker, C user U' with same pool and token path within same block, price impact pattern per Flashbots-style literature (verify chain coverage).
Backrun clustering: profit_to_arb_address / user_trade_notional distribution shift vs baseline.

formulas.mev_pressure_index: MPI_t = (volume_high_residual_t / max(V_t, ε)) * (median_builder_tip_t / median_tip_baseline_t) with clipped ratios.

dashboard_recommendations: Scatter: trade size vs residual colored by builder tip presence

alert_thresholds_examples.mpi_spike: MPI_t > p95 over 90d AND median_residual > 2x prior week — notify
alert_thresholds_examples.sandwich_rate: > 8% of user swaps in 24h on core pool — investigate routing

pipelines: Layer1: robust z-score on volume, depth, unique labeled users (MAD baseline, 60d)
Layer2: changepoint detection (PELT/Bayesian offline) on fee revenue and depth_at_50bps
Layer3: graph spike in new funder→trader edges within 24h (sybil prep)
Gate alerts requiring ≥2 independent signals within same 6h window

formulas.robust_z: z_robust = 0.6745 * (x - median) / MAD over trailing window W

anomaly_detection.reporting_cadence: Streaming alerts operational; postmortem PDF/Notion within 48h of sev-1
anomaly_detection.anti_automation_bias: Tune W per seasonality (weekend vs weekday) using STL decomposition optional

layers.executive: 3–5 cards: fee_revenue_30d, depth_at_50bps_median, product_WAW_30d, treasury_runway_months, MPI_7d
layers.operational: Pool-level depth, volume composition (labeled), bridge netflows, grant outflows
layers.forensic: Tx-level traces, cluster graphs, MEV residual histograms, wash score components

taxonomy: TREASURY_ACTION: multisig transfers, governance executor, known distributor contracts
INCENTIVE_FARMING: interactions with rewarder contracts with rapid stake/unstake cycles
RETAIL_PRODUCT: calls to product allowlist without high MEV residual cluster
MM_BOT: high cancel/replace rate offchain if available; onchain proxy: small trades, tight spread maintenance (limited)
correlation_methodologies: Propensity score matching between incentivized and control pools (offchain experiment design)
Difference-in-differences around incentive start/stop dates on WAW_product
Lead-lag cross-correlation between product signups and first onchain contract call with FDR across lags

formulas.treasury_explained_variance: η = Var(ΔTVL_predicted_from_treasury_flows) / Var(ΔTVL) over window (ridge regression with regularization to avoid overfit)

attribution_models.reporting_cadence: Weekly attribution refresh; major label updates ad hoc

alert_thresholds_examples.treasury_explains_growth: η > 0.6 for 2 weeks — headline growth likely treasury-led

beneficiary_reporting.recipient_registry: Maintain signed CSV/DB: address, entity, role {team, investor, mm, grantee, user}, source_of_truth_doc_url, updated_at

formulas.fee_split_trace: For each fee collection tx, split_j = fee_token_to_address_j / sum_k fee_token_to_address_k at log resolution
formulas.beneficiary_gini: G_fee = Gini({split_j}) across labeled recipients per month

dashboard_recommendations: Sankey: protocol revenue → recipients → subsequent CEX deposit flags (if labeled)
Table: top recipients with entity attestation links
beneficiary_reporting.reporting_cadence: Monthly public beneficiary appendix (where policy allows)

alert_thresholds_examples.unlabeled_fee_spike: >15% of monthly fees to new unlabeled addresses — compliance review hook

vanity_metrics: Raw transaction count without gas and contract filters
Cumulative addresses all-time without churn and recall
Social follower counts as ecosystem KPI
tvl_absolutism: Ranking pools by TVL without depth-at-slippage or range placement
Ignoring double-counted wrapped assets in aggregated TVL feeds
price_only_analytics: Token price vs TVL multiples without fee and user quality context
operational_anti_patterns: Label drift without snapshot versioning reproducibility breaks
